issues.description: Aufgabe 01: The problem text requires outputting the columns ID, Name, Art and URL and explicitly instructs not to rename columns with AS (problem_statement.md line 102). The solution file (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql line 1) renames the id column using an alias ('id AS Kennung'), while the template (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql line 1) and the task description expect the original column name (id). This naming mismatch (Kennung vs id) contradicts the 'do not alias' instruction and may confuse students or the automatic checker about the expected column name.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution, remove the alias so the query returns the original column name exactly as requested. Change solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql line 1 to: SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad'. Alternatively, if the intent is to teach aliasing, update the problem statement to allow or require the alias and document the expected column name in the tests.
